question: What would happen if consciousness were cut off from all things?
premises: Consciousness is by nature awareness itself
If consciousness were cut off from all things it would become a mere object
A mere object would be like a pot defined only by its own mark
inference: Consciousness cannot be cut off from all things without ceasing to be consciousness.
plain_english: If consciousness, whose nature is awareness, were cut off from all things, it would become a mere object, like a pot defined only by its own particular mark.
